input.question: Why would someone go onto a TV "judge" show when they're blatantly in the wrong?
input.ground_truth: Both parties have a pool of money that they are paid in order to appear on the show. If any money is owed to the plaintiff or defender, it is subtracted from that pool, and then the pool is evenly divided between the two parties that have agreed to show up. People might do this because they hope the judge will believe them instead of the other person. Or maybe they think they can trick the judge.
